title: Passwords
description:
Passwords outside the config: `password_cmd` (a shell string or a list), `${ENV}` in
the URL and `passwords.json` (in the comments). Needs `make it-up`. See
`:help dbdash-passwords`.

query.sql: SELECT current_user AS logged_in_as, current_database() AS db

show.title: password_cmd as a string
show.description:
The URL has no password; `password_cmd: "echo dbdash_pw"` runs through the shell and
its first line is the password (use `pass show db/app` or a keychain command).

show.title: password_cmd as a list (no shell)
show.description:
`password_cmd` as a list runs without a shell (here Neovim prints the password). The
command runs in Neovim's current directory; its output is cached.
